title: Build The Earth — Türkiye
subtitle: Everyone thought about this being happening at least once...
body: Everything started when a 17 yo Fabalu saw a YouTube video in 2020 by someone called PippenFTS.
That video was about what Fabalu already tought about like everyone as soon as he played a game called Minecraft. What if we build the whole world inside this blocky game and hang around inside it?
